an obesity epidemic: Because children eat more fast food and exercise less, doctors warn that we are facing an obesity epidemic.
由於孩子們吃更多速食、運動更少，醫生警告我們正面臨肥胖症的蔓延。
reach epidemic proportions: Phone addiction among teenagers has reached epidemic proportions, with many spending over eight hours a day online.
青少年的手機成癮已經達到流行病般的規模，許多人每天上網超過八小時。
an epidemic of violence: The city suffered an epidemic of violence last year, with street fights and robberies happening almost every night.
這座城市去年暴力事件氾濫，街頭鬥毆和搶劫幾乎每晚都在發生。
be equivalent to: One US dollar is roughly equivalent to thirty Taiwan dollars, so the souvenir costs about three hundred NT dollars.
一美元大約相當於三十元新台幣，所以這個紀念品大約三百元新台幣。
the equivalent of a month's salary: The new laptop cost him the equivalent of a month's salary, so he had to save for a long time.
這台新筆電花了他相當於一個月薪水的錢，所以他必須存很久。
roughly equivalent: A high school diploma in Taiwan is roughly equivalent to one in America, so she could apply to college there.
台灣的高中文憑大致等同於美國的高中文憑，所以她可以申請那裡的大學。
stand erect: The guards at the memorial hall stand erect for hours without moving, even on the hottest summer days.
紀念堂的衛兵直挺挺地站立好幾個小時一動也不動，即使在最熱的夏天也是如此。
an erect posture: Sitting with an erect posture, with your back straight, can help prevent pain after long hours of studying.
保持挺直的坐姿、背部打直，有助於避免長時間讀書後的疼痛。
erect a monument: The town decided to erect a monument in the main square to honor the firefighters who died in the earthquake.
鎮上決定在中央廣場豎立一座紀念碑，紀念在地震中殉職的消防員。
be essential to success: Hard work and good time management are essential to success in senior high school, especially before exams.
努力和良好的時間管理對高中生活的成功不可或缺，尤其是在考試前。
essential oils: My mother puts a few drops of lavender essential oils in her bath to help her relax after work.
我媽媽下班後會在洗澡水裡滴幾滴薰衣草精油，幫助她放鬆。
an essential ingredient: Fresh garlic is an essential ingredient in this dish; without it, the soup tastes plain and boring.
新鮮大蒜是這道菜的必要成分；沒有它，湯喝起來平淡無味。
It is essential that…: It is essential that every student bring a raincoat on the hiking trip, because heavy rain is expected in the mountains.
每位學生健行時都帶雨衣是必要的，因為山區預計會下大雨。
essential services: During the typhoon, essential services such as hospitals, police, and fire stations remained open all night.
颱風期間，醫院、警察局和消防局等基本民生服務整夜都持續運作。
eternal life: In many old stories, kings searched far and wide for a magic medicine that could give them eternal life.
在許多古老的故事裡，國王四處尋找能讓他們永生的神奇藥物。
eternal love: At their wedding, the couple promised each other eternal love and exchanged rings in front of their families.
在婚禮上，這對新人在家人面前互許永恆的愛，並交換了戒指。
an eternal optimist: My dad is an eternal optimist; even when it rains on our holiday, he says tomorrow will be sunny.
我爸爸是個永遠的樂觀者；就算假期下雨，他也會說明天會放晴。
the eternal triangle: The TV drama is about the eternal triangle: two best friends who both fall in love with the same girl.
這部電視劇講述的是永恆的三角關係：兩個好朋友同時愛上同一個女孩。
eternal gratitude: The boy's parents expressed their eternal gratitude to the stranger who saved him from drowning in the river.
男孩的父母向那位救他免於溺斃的陌生人表達永遠的感激。
ethical standards: Doctors must follow strict ethical standards and never share their patients' private information without permission.
醫生必須遵守嚴格的道德標準，絕不能未經許可分享病人的隱私資料。
an ethical dilemma: Finding a wallet full of cash put Tim in an ethical dilemma: keep the money or return it to the owner.
撿到一個裝滿現金的錢包讓提姆陷入道德兩難：要把錢留下，還是還給失主。
ethical consumerism: People who practice ethical consumerism buy products from companies that treat workers fairly and protect the environment.
實踐道德消費的人會向公平對待員工、並保護環境的公司購買產品。
be ethically wrong: Many people believe it is ethically wrong to test cosmetics on animals, so they only buy cruelty-free products.
許多人認為用動物測試化妝品在道德上是錯的，所以他們只買無動物實驗的產品。
an ethnic minority: The Atayal people are an ethnic minority in Taiwan, and they are working hard to keep their language alive.
泰雅族是台灣的少數族群之一，他們正努力讓自己的語言延續下去。
ethnic conflict: Years of ethnic conflict between the two groups forced thousands of families to leave their homes and villages.
兩個族群之間多年的族群衝突，迫使數千個家庭離開他們的家園和村莊。
ethnic food: This street is full of ethnic food restaurants, where you can try Thai curry, Indian bread, and Vietnamese noodles.
這條街滿是異國民族風味料理餐廳，你可以品嚐泰式咖哩、印度烤餅和越南河粉。
ethnic cleansing: The United Nations accused the army of ethnic cleansing after it drove a whole minority group out of the country.
聯合國指控該軍隊進行種族清洗，因為它把整個少數民族趕出了國家。
the eventual winner: Although she lost her first two matches, Mia fought back and became the eventual winner of the tennis tournament.
雖然米婭輸了前兩場比賽，但她奮力反擊，成為網球錦標賽最後的贏家。
the eventual outcome: Nobody knows the eventual outcome of the election yet, because millions of votes still need to be counted tonight.
目前還沒人知道選舉的最終結果，因為今晚仍有數百萬張選票需要計算。
eventual (最終的) ≠ 法文 éventuel (可能的): After months of hard work, the team's eventual success made all the long nights worth it.
經過數月的努力，團隊最終的成功讓所有熬夜都值得了。
